name: Temptations
overview: Scripture reveals that temptation is a real and present challenge for believers, who are exhorted to pray and watch diligently to avoid falling into it, recognizing that the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak (Mark 14:38; Luke 22:40). Jesus teaches us to ask God to lead us away from temptation and to deliver us from evil, underscoring the need for divine protection and power (Matthew 6:13). Believers are also cautioned not to give the devil any foothold (Ephesians 4:27), while the experience of Christ Himself in being tempted enables Him to help those who face temptation (Hebrews 2:18). Additionally, trials and temptations are to be counted as occasions for joy, as they refine faith and character (James 1:2).
